svg.title: Snake autopilot replay
svg.desc: A snake plays itself on an 18 by 13 board and eats 12 stack items (Python, TypeScript, Spring Boot, React, Azure OpenAI, LangGraph, RAG, Docker, PostgreSQL, C, x86 ASM, FastAPI). Open the full page to play it yourself with the arrow keys.
svg.text: ARROWS OR WASD TO STEER / SPACE PAUSES / B TOGGLES AUTOPILOT
